landing.title: Renovation cost before the surveyor visits
landing.lead: Six parameters and you see the price range for the standard package. No calls, no sign-up.

steps.title: Instant estimate
steps.text: You set the area, property type and scope of work. The range is computed in your browser, instantly.

steps.title: Request with files
steps.text: After signing up you upload the BTI floor plan and design references. Files are optional.

steps.title: Quote from an estimator
steps.text: The estimator prepares a detailed quote within 1–2 business days. You accept or reject it.

landing.packageNote: Design solutions are not covered — they are priced individually.
packageItems: Electrical wiring and water supply to a standard layout
Levelling of walls, floors and ceilings
Standard doors, coverings and plumbing from the base range

calculator.title: Instant estimate
calculator.subtitle: Six fields. No sign-up required.
calculator.designerHint: The designer package is priced individually — no amount is shown in the browser.

validation.areaRange: Area must be between 10 and 1000 m²

result.title: Preliminary estimate
result.validityNote: Valid for 30 days. After that the cost is recalculated at the current rates.
result.disclaimer: Preliminary estimate. The exact cost is set after the survey.
result.toRequest: Send a request to an estimator
result.empty: No estimate found. Start with the calculator.

designer.title: This project requires an individual quote
designer.text: The quote will be ready within 2 business days. Design solutions do not follow a formula — the estimator prices them from your materials.
designer.noPriceNote: That is why no amount is shown here — neither an approximation nor a range.

register.title: Sign up
register.lead: The estimator needs these details to prepare the quote and reach you.
register.estimateAttached: Your estimate will be linked to the account.

fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, one letter and one digit

validation.passwordWeak: Needs at least one letter and one digit

verify.title: E-mail verification
verify.sentText: We sent a link to {{email}}. The link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.sentTextNoEmail: We sent a link to your inbox. The link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.resendDone: The message has been sent again.
verify.successText: You can now send a request to an estimator.
verify.expiredText: Links live for 24 hours. Request a new one — it goes to the same address.
verify.usedText: The e-mail was verified earlier. Sign in to your account.
verify.invalidText: Check that you copied the whole address, or request a new message.
verify.bannerText: Until the address is verified you cannot send a request.

new.title: Request for a quote
new.lead: Attach the BTI plan and design references. A request can be sent without files too.
new.noEstimate: No estimate attached — the estimator will price from scratch.
new.commentPlaceholder: What matters: deadlines, material preferences, specifics of the property
new.activeExists: You already have an active request.
